question: Segments \(AC\) and \(BD\) intersect at point \(O\), with \(OA=OC\), \(OB=OD\), and \(AB=7\). Find the length of \(CD\).
solution: \(\angle AOB=\angle COD\) (vertically opposite angles), \(OA=OC\), and \(OB=OD\), so \(\triangle AOB\cong\triangle COD\) by SAS. Thus, \(CD=AB=7\).

solutionMethods.explanation: The equalities \(OA=OC\) and \(OB=OD\) show that \(O\) is the midpoint of both \(AC\) and \(BD\). These are the diagonals of quadrilateral \(ABCD\), so its diagonals bisect each other. A quadrilateral whose diagonals bisect each other is a parallelogram. Its opposite sides are equal, giving \(CD=AB=7\).
solutionMethods.label: Recognize a parallelogram
